item.title: AI News, Thursday October 22
item.description:
Thursday October 22: OpenAI's models in Google Cloud, Claude Duet plus Anthropic's breaking API version 2026-10-21, Kling 4.0 on Higgsfield and Runway, FastH3 Omni running locally on an M5 Max, ElevenLabs Realtime Translation, TV4/Mastiff's lost Challenge Sverige edit (backup failure, not AI), TV 2 Norway's AI subtitle slip, EBU and NVIDIA on sovereign AI agents, and WGA East's Cloak deal.

  1. OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud – GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Luna in private preview in Model Garden; Codex connects now; GA in coming weeks ([Google Cloud blog](https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/ai-machine-learning/google-cloud-brings-openai-models-to-customers))
  2. Introducing Claude Duet – proactive agent, US Pro/Max waitlist; plus [API version 2026-10-21](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/migration-2026-10-21): temperature/top_p/top_k now return 400, Python SDK 2.0, Bearer auth
  3. Kling 4.0 on Higgsfield – 3-30s, 10 keyframes, 15 references, edit finished clips, stereo sound, launch discount; also [on Runway](https://runway.com/product/models/kling-4.0)
  4. FastH3 Omni goes local: DGX Spark, RTX and Apple Silicon – 5s 480p from one photo: 62s on RTX 5090, 19.5 min on M5 Max via MLX (4.7 min with reference shrink)
  5. ElevenLabs launches Eleven Realtime Translation – live two-way voice translation on Eleven v4 Turbo, 90+ languages, enterprise alpha
  6. No, AI didn't delete a Swedish reality TV series – TV4 says a failed backup and human error lost Mastiff's edited Challenge Sverige; recut pushes premiere to 2027
  7. Norwegian TV 2 apologises for AI subtitle blunder – AI-subtitled Skal vi danse replay on TV 2 Play misspelled judges' and contestants' names
  8. EBU and NVIDIA on sovereign AI agents for public broadcasters – reference architectures with Microsoft, Nebius and Qvest; no timeline or pricing yet
  9. WGA East strikes deal with Cloak – free for members, $10 for non-members, makes scripts resistant to AI scraping

item.title: AI News, Wednesday October 21
item.description:
Wednesday October 21: FastH3 Omni open weights, Ben Vallack's Claude Code edit suite, Mosaic's Motion video agent, Runway in Claude Marketplace, Higgsfield CLI, Tripo EdenLive, Gemini business tools with Nano Banana 2.1 plus the Veo 3.1 preview shutdown, Nordic voices on AI at MIPCOM, and Anthropic's draft IPO prospectus.

  1. FastH3-Omni: open-weight "unlimited Seedance" – distilled MiniMax H3 with image/video/audio references, 5-15s with sound, 5.6-11.9× lower latency on 8 GB200s ([FastVideo](https://haoailab.com/blogs/fastvideo-omniref-update/))
  2. Ben Vallack had Claude Code build his edit suite – transcript cutting, transcribed B-roll library, phone trim app and timecoded voice-note review, no Final Cut
  3. Mosaic introduces Motion, the General Video Agent – edits, motion design, color and sync; exports to Premiere, After Effects, Resolve (no FCP); framework cost test
  4. Runway joins Claude Marketplace – buy Runway Creative with Anthropic commitment; Claude powers Runway Agent
  5. Higgsfield CLI guide – open source, browser sign-in, same credits (no Unlimited); Seedance 2.5 5s 1080p 80 credits, 15 in draft
  6. Tripo AI launches EdenLive – real-time 720p generative rendering at 24+ fps on one RTX 5090, restyling and previs
  7. New Gemini tools for small business owners – saved brand style with Nano Banana 2.1; plus [Veo 3.1 previews retire as early as Oct 22](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/deprecations)
  8. Scale, survival and the AI question at MIPCOM – SVT sees AI-generated factual in the pipeline; Banijay's Lucas Green on Nordic IP; archive-for-training ethics
  9. Anthropic's draft IPO prospectus – per WSJ: H1 revenue $16.3B, $80.7B net loss (≈$72B non-cash), tentative November IPO

item.title: AI News, Tuesday October 20
item.description:
Tuesday October 20: FLUX 3 Max on fal (22× faster than Seedance 2.5, per fal), Kling 4.0 with 10 keyframes, stereo audio and MCP/CLI, VideoGen's 10-minute Model 1, the Veo 3.1 preview API shutdown on Oct 22, Higgsfield Supercomputer, Runway Project Continuum, Viggle JST-2, Banijay's archive-to-social work with Moments Lab, Finland's AI-built true-crime series plus a Copenhagen AI workshop for editors, and OpenAI's $30B race ahead of Anthropic's IPO.

  1. fal launches FLUX 3 Max, claiming 22× faster AI video than Seedance 2.5 – ~12.5s per 10s clip in fal's test, ties the leaders on Artificial Analysis I2V, 10-keyframe endpoint, 75% off until Nov 7
  2. Kling AI drops version 4.0 – 30s single pass, 10 keyframes, 15 references, stereo audio, Flash variant, MCP and CLI access
  3. VideoGen unveils Model 1 for ten-minute videos from one prompt – unverified claims (~80% of Seedance 2.5 at <50% cost); $1M credit pool for filmmakers open now
  4. Gemini API deprecations: Veo 3.1 previews shut down Oct 22 – veo-3.1 (standard/fast/lite) preview endpoints retire; replacement is gemini-omni-1.1-flash ([tracker](https://synon.co.jp/article/news/2026-10-19-video-gen-ai-daily))
  5. Higgsfield launches Marketing Studio and Supercomputer – agent layer that plans multi-step work across Kling, Seedance and LLMs; imports Claude Code skills
  6. Runway Labs: Project Continuum – research app for real-time generated video "portals" and agent Visual Thinking
  7. Introducing Viggle JST-2 – physics-native world model: 3D scenes in ~1s for <$0.01, rig-free characters, motion from text or video
  8. How Banijay activates its IP with Moments Lab – MXT-3 indexes 200k+ hours; Banijay Brazil clips up 50% to 40/week ([ClipHub deal](https://www.banijay.com/blog/2026/10/15/banijay-benelux-partners-with-cliphub-to-accelerate-creator-led-audience-growth/))
  9. The Dark Side: Finnish true crime with generative AI scenes – WBITVP Finland for Nelonen/Ruutu; tools: Nano Banana Pro, Kling, Higgsfield ([Origodesign](https://origodesign.fi/blog/pimea-puoli)); plus [Filmværksted AI workshop for editors](https://www.filmvaerksted.dk/events/ai-med-peter-stenbaek---for-klippere), Copenhagen, from Oct 25
  10. OpenAI races to raise $30B ahead of Anthropic IPO – >$1.4T valuation target; Anthropic Q3 revenue $16.8B; IPO expected mid-November

item.title: AI News, Monday October 19
item.description:
Monday October 19: Meta Muse Spark Open on Mac Studios (with a DaVinci Resolve demo), Krea 3 vs Nano Banana on speed/price, Topaz Starlight Fast 3, FLUX 3 Video at 2K/4K on Krea, Elorian Glimpse for visual reasoning, HelixWorld open-source AV worlds, Banijay at MIPCOM on drama and bottom-line AI, the post-Sora video stack remap, and Apple’s Oct 28 LA launch experience.

  1. Meta Muse Spark Open on Apple Mac Studios – 816B MoE open-weight model (42B active, 1M context) runs on two M5 Ultra Mac Studios via MLX; Meta demoed Muse Code driving DaVinci Resolve frame-by-frame ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/15/apple-meta-partner-ai.html))
  2. Introducing Krea 3 – native 2K image edits in under 8s at $0.06; Krea’s platform timing puts Nano Banana Pro ~33s / $0.135; default model as of Oct 16 ([changelog](https://www.krea.ai/docs/changelog))
  3. Topaz Starlight Fast 3 – up to 4× Starlight Precise 2.6, scene splitting, ~7 fps at 1080p; now on Krea Enhancer (Starlight v1 retired there)
  4. FLUX 3 Video – up to 20s with optional native audio; Krea added 2K/4K output Oct 16; Magnific CPO Omar Pera quoted on BFL page
  5. Elorian Glimpse – visual-reasoning model that re-inspects pixels mid-thought; $0.60/$3 per M tokens; TechCrunch on $55M seed / Andrew Dai ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/16/elorians-first-ai-model-wants-to-reason-with-images-not-just-about-them/))
  6. Helix World – real-time interactive video + spatial stereo from one image (Noiz AI + HKUST); demo at helixworld.org, code on GitHub ([NoizAI/HelixWorld](https://github.com/NoizAI/HelixWorld))
  7. MIPCOM 2026 takeaways: Banijay, YouTube, AI – Banijay+All3Media ~265k-hour library; AI talk shifted to integrating/monetizing existing business
  8. AI video in October 2026: the Sora API is gone – Sora API returns 410 since Sept 25; practical Veo / Seedance / Wan / FLUX / Runway lanes (Kling 4.0 since fully live mid-Oct)
  9. Apple inviting media to October 28 launch experience – touchscreen MacBooks, iPad mini, M6 Macs per Gurman; FCP 13 still unannounced

item.title: AI News, Friday October 16
item.description:
Friday October 16: a lost Challenge Sverige edit at Banijay's Mastiff, Kling 4.0 fully live with MCP and CLI, ElevenLabs Instant Soundtracks, HeyGen's scene-aware voice, an open-source 3D previs builder for coding agents, AI drama on EBS and an AI Andy Cohen on Peacock, Apple's Oct 28 Mac launch, Claude Code Review GA, and Banijay's AI-indexed archive.

  1. Entire Swedish reality show season lost weeks before premiere amid disputed AI claims – TV4 pushes The Challenge Sverige to 2027; TV4 and Mastiff (a Banijay label) blame human error and a failed backup, not an AI agent ([Omni/TT](https://omni.se/tv4-dementerar-ai-uppgift/a/d7jPVA), [Aftonbladet on cost](https://www.aftonbladet.se/nojesbladet/a/4O0Lb6/efter-raderade-the-challenge-sasongen-sa-manga-miljoner-kostar-det))
  2. Kling 4.0 goes fully live – 30s native takes, 10 keyframes, 15 Omni References; MCP and CLI access, 10-bit HDR and API still coming ([Runtime Wire](https://runtimewire.com/article/kling-ai-kling-4-mcp-cli-availability)); coming soon to Higgsfield ([quicknews](https://quicknews.hu/hir/hamarosan-erkezik-a-kling-4-0-a-higgsfield-platformjara))
  3. ElevenLabs Instant Soundtracks – upload a video, get an original score plus timed SFX on separate layers; API can return music and SFX as separate files
  4. HeyGen Voice: scene-aware voice cloning – adapts delivery and room acoustics to the scene image; #1 on Artificial Analysis controlled-voice leaderboard (Oct 9 snapshot, Elo 1201) ([press release](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/heygen-launches-heygen-voice-debuting-172000180.html))
  5. Topview 3D Builder open-sourced – local, agent-driven 3D scene blocking and reference frames for AI video; works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor (Apache-2.0)
  6. EBS AI Literature Hall premieres Oct 16 – 13 single-director generative AI dramas on EBS 1TV; plus Peacock's AI Andy Cohen hosting Your Bravoverse ([SLOP TV News](https://sloptvnews.com/peacock-your-bravoverse-ai-andy-cohen/))
  7. Apple inviting media to Oct 28 launch experience – touchscreen OLED MacBook Pros, iPad mini, M6 Macs ([AppleInsider](https://appleinsider.com/articles/26/10/15/touch-screen-macbook-pro-will-be-unveiled-on-october-28)); FCP 13 still unannounced ([FCP 13 leak](https://appleinsider.com/articles/26/10/01/final-cut-pro-13-leaks-ahead-of-announcement-with-several-new-features))
  8. Claude Code Review is generally available – ~3x faster reviews, Quick/Standard/Deep per repo; Opus 5.5 fast mode GA ([Chasing Next](https://chasingnext.com/updates/claude-opus-5-5-fast-mode-generally-available)); METR embedded evaluators ([Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/news/an-update-on-independent-evaluators))
  9. How Banijay activates its 200,000-hour archive with Moments Lab – MXT-3 indexing and Studio clipping; Banijay Brazil clip output up 50%; plus Banijay Benelux x ClipHub creator deal ([Banijay](https://www.banijay.com/blog/2026/10/15/banijay-benelux-partners-with-cliphub-to-accelerate-creator-led-audience-growth/))

item.title: AI News, Thursday October 15
item.description:
Thursday October 15: Gemini 4 Argon goes global, Grok Imagine Video 1.5 adds face and voice references, Higgsfield's Genjutsu motion-transfer API, Kling hybrid pipelines from Busan, Fox Nation's all-AI Houdini doc, Nicolas Cage and digital-double waivers, a copyright stress test naming Nano Banana and Seedance, the EU's first AI Act probes, and a Danish desk with Copenhagen AI events plus Banijay at MIPCOM.

  1. Gemini 4 Argon is now available for everyone – global rollout Oct 13, $2/$10 intro pricing, Blender MCP + Nano Banana demos; Antigravity in the Gemini macOS app ([Gemini app post](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/products/gemini-app/gemini-4-argon-availability/))
  2. Imagine Video 1.5 with References – image and voice references, text-to-video, native 1080p; API reference mode up to 14 images, 15s, 720p ([xAI docs](https://docs.x.ai/developers/model-capabilities/video/reference-to-video)); unannounced music panel ([ArtRealmAI](https://artrealmai.com/article/grok-imagine-music-in-app-video-soundtracks))
  3. Higgsfield Genjutsu API + ComfyUI node – motion transfer from a 4–30s clip with up to 8 references, 50% off through Oct 31; plus 10+ minute videos with GPT-6 Astra ([OpenAI case study](https://openai.com/index/higgsfield-longer-videos-voice/))

item.title: AI News, Wednesday October 14
item.description:
Wednesday October 14: Netflix Eyeline hybrid AI production, Kang's 40% budget claim and Weta's color limits, Kling 4.0's October rollout, a Kling/Veo/Seedance shootout, Apple's Remnants on Vision Pro, Magnific One and ElevenLabs Brand Kits, Nano Banana 2.1 on Higgsfield, and macOS 27 for FCP shops.

  1. How AI is used at Netflix Eyeline Studios – Mousavi at View Conference on hybrid production, sparse sets, and the last 30–40% to broadcast quality
  2. Netflix AI on ~300 titles; Kang cites up to 40% budget savings – Busan panel with Weta's Thurston on assistive AI and color-volume limits ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/10/netflix-ai-weta-fx-kimball-thurston-run-to-the-west-1237153889/))
  3. Kling 4.0 early access and October rollout – 30s clips, 10 keyframes, Omni Reference; PROMPTR music-video case study ([VOZMI](https://vozmi.app/blog/kling-4-0-viral-ai-music-video))
  4. Kling 4.0 vs Veo 3.1 vs Seedance 2.5 – pick by job: keyframes vs references vs short cinematic shots
  5. Remnants immersive horror on Vision Pro – Ti West, Oct 16 exclusive; 8K 180° Spatial Audio ([9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/10/12/apple-unveils-immersive-horror-film-coming-to-vision-pro-this-week/))
  6. Magnific One launches with Brand Kit – art-direction layer on GPT Image 2; draft then final to 4K
  7. ElevenLabs Brand Kit in ElevenCreative – reusable visual identity tagged into Image & Video, Flows, and agent
  8. Nano Banana 2.1 on Higgsfield – up to 4K, 14 references; plus Katana Claude skill ([Android Authority](https://www.androidauthority.com/google-launches-nano-banana-2-1-3719823/))
  9. macOS 27 Golden Gate for video editors – FCP 12.4 Cinematic mode needs Golden Gate; Adobe ok, Avid not qualified

item.title: AI News, Tuesday October 13
item.description:
Tuesday October 13: an AI-made Christmas feature on Seedance, Nano Banana and ElevenLabs, new crew roles from Busan, Banderas in an AI epic, a possible Sora comeback, a physics benchmark, previs in code, and Meta's first frontier model.

  1. Merry the Christmas Witch made for $1.5M instead of $80M – hybrid AI feature using ElevenLabs, Seedance and Nano Banana
  2. Kim Sung-soo on folding AI into his craft – Busan panel on hybrid drama and the new "AI coordinator" crew role
  3. Antonio Banderas to star in AI-powered Cortés – Utopai and Ex Machina Studios, in production in Paris
  4. OpenAI's Sora could get a second act – talks with a filmmaker-focused startup from Katzenberg and Bill Peebles
  5. Seedance 2.5 tops an AI video physics benchmark – 57.76 out of 100 across 40 measured physics tasks
  6. Microsoft's Code Video Model plans shots in code like previs – Three.js previs guides MiniMax H3
  7. Kandinsky 6.0 Video released open source – synced 44 kHz audio and video under MIT license
  8. Vivix W1 real-time interactive video – streaming-native model you can steer while it generates
  9. Meta releases Muse Wonder, its first frontier model – comparable to Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra in Meta's tests
  10. ElevenLabs launches Architect – assistant that diagnoses and fixes voice agents (and see [Eleven v4](https://elevenlabs.io/blog/eleven-v4))
  11. Bonus: Final Cut Pro release notes – 12.4 (Sept 29) is still the latest; FCP 13 not yet announced

item.title: AI News, Monday October 12
item.description:
Monday October 12: Netflix's AI use, video tools inside the chat window, Vidu Q4, an XPRIZE trailer heading for features, agent safety, and a Final Cut Pro 13 leak.

  1. Netflix has used AI on about 300 titles – Busan panel with Kang Yun-sung and Wētā FX (also see Variety: https://variety.com/2026/tv/festivals/netflix-ai-300-titles-kang-yoon-sung-40-percent-budget-busan-1236907359/)
  2. Higgsfield Katana runs inside Claude via MCP – conversational video editing powered by Claude Motion
  3. invideo Agentic Extend – extend scenes up to 30 seconds with picture, dialogue, music and SFX
  4. Voyager launches an AI harness for creative tools – drives Premiere, Resolve, Final Cut Pro and more
  5. Vidu Q4 Preview – 4K 10-bit, up to 15 image references
  6. ElevenLabs Brand Kit – reusable colors, fonts, logos and references in ElevenCreative
  7. Runway Solaris – an interface world model built on Gen-4.5
  8. AI trailer wins $2.5M XPRIZE, heads for ~$10M feature – backed by Google and Range Media
  9. Anthropic discloses unintended agent actions – and the White House says incident reporting is not optional (https://rainvent.ai/genai-daily-october-11-2026-anthropic-pulls-internet-from-evals-white-house-makes-incident-reporting-mandatory-firmus-scraps-5b-ipo/)
  10. UK AISI regains pre-release model testing – after a 17-day pause
  11. Bonus: Final Cut Pro 13 leaks – Pixelmator round-trip, Natural Motion Blur, keyframe easing
